examples.japanese: 雨が降っても行きます。
examples.reading: あめがふってもいきます。
examples.gloss: I will go even if it rains.
I will buy it even if it is expensive.

examples.japanese: 何度聞いても分かりません。
examples.reading: なんどきいてもわかりません。
examples.gloss: However many times I ask, I do not understand.

usage: Often paired with a question word: いくら〜ても, 何度〜ても.
It states a hypothetical or general case. For a fact that goes against expectation, use のに.

compare.difference: のに is about a real fact that contradicts what you expected. ても is hypothetical or "regardless of".
たら says "if / when X, then Y". ても says "even if X, still Y".
